slides.headline:
Run a 5s that
*never*
cancels.
slides.sub: 6 habits from organisers who play every week. Save this.

slides.title: Same day. *Same time.*
slides.body: A fixed slot becomes a habit. Habits don't cancel.

slides.title: Invite *12* for 10 spots
slides.body: Two always drop. Plan for it, don't panic about it.

slides.title: Keep a *waiting list*
slides.body: Names 11 and 12 move up the second someone pulls out.

slides.title: Court money *up front*
slides.body: Collect before kick-off, not after. No chasing all week.

slides.title: One link for *subs*
slides.body: Share it outside the group when you're short.

slides.title: Notice who *shows up*
slides.body: Your regulars are gold. Ask them first next week.

slides.headline:
We're building
all six into
*one link*.
slides.body: Free for organisers in Cape Town. Coming soon.
